invariants: The registration stage recomputes every byte count and SHA-256 stored in the frozen Phase 0 index.
MANTRA-owned restoration and replay evidence enters the RICO graph through prior-run artifact references.
The stage records successful declared file opens and writes one terminal receipt.

findings.invariant: MANTRA-owned restoration and replay evidence enters the RICO graph through prior-run artifact references.
findings.counterexample: A caller can supply ordinary local input declarations for restoration_bindings, restoration_evidence, hopfield_replay_receipt, and mil_replay_receipt. The builder accepts the names and produces a disconnected provenance graph.
findings.repair: Require RunArtifactDraft for the four MANTRA producer inputs and add a focused rejection test for an external input substituted at each boundary.

exclusions: The real registration run remains blocked until restoration and both replay runs produce their retained artifacts.
